facts.value: Are you passionate about designing spaces that are visually engaging, functional, sustainable and culturally relevant? A Bachelor of Science in Design in architectural studies online from Arizona State University may be a good fit. You’ll graduate with a foundation in design principles, project-based experiences and the ability to contribute positively to the built environment and community.
